gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-004 addresses an unproved equality between Omega-side and D-side normal-derivative fluxes in a Green identity argument. It does not identify the separate displayed-formula error in which the tangential exact differential integral d\phi is asserted to be the normal flux, nor does it provide the normal-flux replacement for that displayed identity.

ISSUE-003 diagnoses use of arc-length measure instead of the oriented differential in the complex double-layer operator. It does not recognize the distinct sign error in the quadratic term of f_G or the resulting false item (3) of the complex-layer lemma.

ISSUE-005 concerns omission of the rank-one mean term in the Steklov pencil and the resulting restricted eigenproblem. It does not identify the separate weighted-transpose error D_s=H^{-1}D^TH versus D^T caused by nonuniform arc-length weights.

ISSUE-003 concerns the measure used in the continuous complex double-layer integral and its jump relations. It does not diagnose the separate discrete product-quadrature double weighting of w_j in h_j^k R_j^k or supply the specific corrected singular-block coefficient.

ISSUE-005 directly identifies that the implemented right-hand matrix is S(I-M) rather than the stated modified operator S_0=S(I-M)+M, explains the loss of the constant-density/zero mode and the resulting restricted eigenproblem, and prescribes adding the rank-one term. This is the same omitted-term defect as the gold issue.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The printed Steklov generalized eigenvalue pencil omits the rank-one mean term M from the right-hand operator, so it represents S(I-M) rather than S_0=S(I-M)+M, annihilates constant densities, and fails to represent the full Steklov problem including the zero mode.
